description: Instrument sensitivity audit for all X_i potential-scaling discriminating tests; CF4 two-intercept mixture correction.

cf4_mixture.interpretation: The pooled +5.4e5 wrong-sign slope is manufactured by imposing a single intercept on two reductions whose zero-points differ by ~+0.12 mag and whose X_i distributions are disjoint in the mean (corr(X_i, R22)=0.44). With per-reduction intercepts the slope is consistent with zero and with the TEP prediction.

cf4_pooled_single_intercept.note: Wrong-sign point estimate is a mixture artifact: the R22-matched registration flag correlates with X_i (r=0.44), so the imposed single intercept forces the cross-reduction zero-point difference into the slope. See cf4_two_intercept.

cf4_two_intercept.note: Per-reduction intercepts: slope 1.72e+05 +- 4.06e+05 (null), alpha_R22 = +0.119 +- 0.080 mag — the detected 'constant pipeline offset' is X_i-correlated (r=0.44). Consistent with zero and with the TEP prediction at |d|/sigma = 1.32.

teph0_raw_primary.note: Unregistered SH0ES Cepheid + EDD/CCHP TRGB, N=18.

jwst_r22_combination.note: Inter-team combination (R22 Cepheid x JWST TRGB). The R22 P-L fit absorbs part of the X_i-dependent signal — the R22-MF2023 offset correlates with X_i (r=+0.28 VIH) — so the applicable slope prediction for this combination is attenuated below kappa_Cep; recorded as the residual adverse cell.

jwst_mf2023_vi_same_team.note: Same-team MF2023 VI Cepheid x JWST TRGB, N=13 — the only homogeneous reduction pair at ~1sigma sensitivity. Correct sign and amplitude-consistent (unscaled consistency 0.13sigma).

band_mf2023_vih_minus_vi.note: Predicted band-differential slope -5.60e+04 vs instrument sigma 2.02e+05 — non-discriminating by construction (sensitivity 0.28 sigma). M101 Cook's D = 44.2; exclusion flips to -1.15e+06 (correct sign).
band_mf2023_vih_minus_vi.robust_estimator_note: Converged Student-t (nu=4) slope is negative (TEP sign) — the WLS positive slope is the M101 leverage draw; prior pipeline runs reported an unconverged optimizer echo (slope == WLS start, err ~ 1.0) that was fixed by parameter rescaling in step_49.

band_key_project_cross_team.note: Key Project optical vs R22 NIR, N=9.

sn_xi_step_measured_vrot.note: N=134 measured-V_rot hosts; mass-corrected xi coefficient 1.425e+04 +- 3.411e+04.

verdict: No current sample delivers >~2sigma expected significance at the fitted kappa_Cep, so null and leverage-driven draws are the expected regime. The pooled-CF4 wrong sign is a demonstrated registration-mixture artifact (two-intercept slope null, offset +0.12 mag detected and X_i-correlated); the same-team MF2023 VI x JWST-TRGB comparison returns the predicted negative slope at the predicted amplitude; the band differential is non-discriminating by construction (0.28sigma sensitivity); the JWST x R22 combination is the residual adverse cell, conditioned on the stated P-L-absorption mechanism. A decisive scaling test requires the expanded same-team JWST matched sample.
